data.one_liner: LaTeX math parser and layout engine in pure Dart with OpenType fonts.
data.what_it_does: Parses and lays out LaTeX mathematical formulas in pure Dart without native code or web views. Supports line breaking, right-to-left math, speech output, and OpenType math fonts.
use_when: You need to render LaTeX math formulas in pure Dart or across all Flutter platforms without WebViews.
You are building an LLM streaming chat interface that needs to render incomplete mathematical formulas safely.
You need formula layout measurements or speech output in non-Flutter or Flutter environments.
avoid_when: You need full, general-purpose HTML/CSS document rendering rather than math typesetting.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation runs anywhere Dart runs (VM, Flutter, server, web).
Never throws on bad input, gracefully handling unfinished LLM streams or diagnostics.
Supports broad LaTeX coverage including amsmath, physics, and chemistry packages.
weaknesses: Requires an additional companion package (`val_latex_flutter`) to get Flutter widgets like `Math` and `MathText`.
data.setup_notes: Add val_latex to your pubspec.yaml via dart pub add val_latex.
